summary: Ukrainian allows zero copular predication in many present contexts; бути supplies overt tense, while є and other constructions serve existence/presence and some copular uses.

semantic_map.SEM.IDENTITY_EQUIVALENCE: present zero copula or є in marked/formal contexts; бути in past/future
semantic_map.SEM.CLASSIFICATION_ROLE: present zero copula + class/role predicate; бути in other tenses
semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: present zero copula + adjective/property predicate; бути in other tenses
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: present zero copula / бути + state predicate according to tense
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: бути + result-state predicate or lexical result construction
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: бути / знаходитися; present location may omit copula in suitable structures
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: відбуватися / бути according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: є / існує according to existence type
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: у + possessor + є is an existential-style possession pattern; мати also available
